deadlines._motion_or_appeal: A motion (Form I-290B) or an appeal is due within 30 days of a decision, 33 when the decision was mailed (8 CFR 103.3(a)(2), 103.5(a)(1), 103.8(b)). The decision letter states the deadline and the right to appeal or not: the attorney reads it.
deadlines._ead_renewal: A work permit renewal may be filed up to 180 days before the card expires (USCIS, Form I-765 instructions).
deadlines._receipt_expected: Firm choice: a filing with no receipt notice this many days after it was mailed gets checked (lockbox rejection, lost mail, payment).
deadlines._naturalization: Form N-400 may be filed 90 days before the client reaches the required years as a permanent resident: 5 years, or 3 when married to and living with a U.S. citizen spouse (INA 316(a), 319(a), 334(a)).
deadlines._rfe_mail: Firm choice: an RFE or NOID response is mailed at least this many days before its due date. USCIS must RECEIVE it by then. Inside this margin the check asks for overnight courier.
deadlines._court_filing: Immigration Court Practice Manual, version released February 20, 2020 (data/reference/ic_practice_manual.pdf), Chapter 3.1(b): non-detained, filings are due at least 15 days before an individual calendar hearing, and at least 15 days before a master calendar hearing when asking for a ruling at or before it; responses within 10 days of the filing. Detained: as the court specifies. Chapter 3.1(c)(ii)(B): the hearing is day 0, calendar days count, and a deadline on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday moves to the next business day. EOIR revises the manual: the attorney confirms against the current online version.
deadlines._card_renewal: Form I-90 may be filed when a 10-year green card has expired or will expire within 6 months (Form I-90 Instructions, 01/20/25).
deadlines.court_filing_source: Immigration Court Practice Manual 3.1(b), version of 02/20/2020
deadlines._n336: A denied N-400: request a hearing on Form N-336 within 30 days after the client receives the denial (8 CFR 336.2(a)). The timeline counts 33 from the notice date when it was mailed; the attorney checks the date it was received.
deadlines._daca_renewal: DACA renewals (src/daca.py), read 2026-10-02: USCIS 'strongly encourage[s]' filing 'between 120 and 150 days (4 to 5 months) before the expiration date located on your current Form I-797 DACA approval notice' (uscis.gov/DACA, updated 01/24/2025, and uscis.gov/i-821d, updated 06/01/2026); filed more than 150 days before, USCIS 'may reject your submission and return it' (I-821D Instructions 01/20/25, CAUTION). Filed within one year after the last DACA period expired (and not terminated) it is a renewal; later, an initial request (I-821D Instructions; DACA litigation FAQ Q5, Q6, Q17, Q18, updated 12/31/2024).

steps._note: What the firm does at each stage, by who does it. Shown on the case's timeline; a step can be marked done.
intake: Invite the client to the portal and collect the questionnaire, identity documents and any court or USCIS papers they already have.
Screen the case: SIJ needs a client under 21 and unmarried, with a state court able to make the SIJ findings before the 21st birthday.
state_court: File the state-court case that asks for the SIJ findings early enough to file the I-360 before the 21st birthday (the client's state decides the court and any earlier age limit).
When the order arrives, add it to the folder: the system reads it and moves the case on to the I-360.
i360_ready: Prepare the I-360 packet (Filing packet tab → I-360 petition (SIJ)).
Answer the I-360 questions only the attorney can answer, sign, and file before the 21st birthday.
i360_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder as it arrives (receipt, any request for evidence, the approval).
visa_wait: Nothing to file until the priority date is current; the system compares it with each month's Visa Bulletin once the bulletin is set.
Remind the client that SIJ requires staying unmarried until the green card is approved.
i485_ready: Prepare the I-485 packet (Filing packet tab → I-485 packet). The civil surgeon must sign the medical exam (Form I-693) no more than 60 days before filing.
Sign off the open attorney items and file while the priority date is current.
i485_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder as it arrives; the system lists the appointments and anything due.
Prepare the client before any interview.
family_ready: Prepare the family packet (Filing packet tab → Family (I-130 + I-485)): I-130, I-130A and I-864 with the I-485.
Confirm the sponsor's income meets this year's guidelines, or arrange a joint sponsor.
family_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder as it arrives; the system lists the appointments and anything due.
Prepare the petitioner and the client before the interview.
resident: Tell the client when they can apply for citizenship (the date is on this timeline).
When the date is near, prepare the N-400 (Filing packet tab → Citizenship (N-400)). The Citizenship panel shows the exact date, the days abroad and what the folder must match.
n400_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder as it arrives (receipt, biometrics, the interview).
Prepare the client for the interview: the English and civics tests (unless exempt), and every answer on the N-400. The officer goes through it.
Remind the client: no trips of 6 months or more, and no arrests, until the oath. Good moral character and residence must last until then.
citizen: Copy the Certificate of Naturalization into the file. Remind the client to apply for a U.S. passport and update their Social Security record if 12.a was No.
If the client's certificate is lost, stolen, damaged or wrong, record why on the replacement-certificate form (Filing packet tab → More… → Replacement certificate (N-565)).
asylum_ready: Prepare the I-589 packet (Filing packet tab → Asylum (I-589)). The client's account (Parts B and C) is written with the attorney; long answers go on supplement sheets automatically.
Review the claim and every Yes with its explanation; read the application to the client in their language before they sign Part D.
asylum_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder (receipt, biometrics, the interview). Watch for the Annual Asylum Fee notice: it must be paid online within 30 days, or USCIS cannot approve the case.
Prepare the client for the asylum interview; bring an interpreter if the client needs one (USCIS no longer provides one in most cases: check the notice).
asylee: Tell the client: one year after the grant they can apply for a green card (Form I-485), and they should not travel to the country they fled.
caa_wait: Collect the proof of Cuban birth or citizenship (the Cuban passport, the Cuban birth certificate with its translation), the I-94 or parole paper, and proof of each month in the U.S. (lease, bills, pay stubs, school records).
Confirm how the client was let in (admitted, or paroled under INA 212(d)(5)(A); a release on Form I-220A is for the attorney to assess) and the day the year in the U.S. began.
caa_ready: Prepare the green card packet (Filing packet tab → More… → Green card under the Cuban Adjustment Act or HRIFA). The civil surgeon's sealed Form I-693 goes with it.
Answer the eligibility questions on the panel, review Part 9 and sign off before filing.
consular: Record the NVC case number and each date as it happens (Filing packet tab → More… → Immigrant visa).
Send the client the DS-260 answer sheet to check, and collect the civil documents on the checklist.
Review the DS-260 answers (especially the security questions) before the client submits it, and the financial evidence before it goes to NVC.
oath: Record the oath ceremony from the notice (Form N-445): its date, time and place, on this page.
Remind the client: answer the N-445 questions truthfully on the day (trips, arrests, since the interview), bring the green card. It is handed in.
family_wait: Add every I-130 notice to the folder: its receipt notice prints the priority date. The system compares it with each month's family Visa Bulletin once the bulletin is set.
When the date is current: the I-485 if the client can adjust in the U.S., else the immigrant visa through NVC (and an I-601A waiver if unlawful presence bars them).
vawa_ready: Answer the VAWA questions with the client somewhere private, choose the safe mailing address, and decide whether the I-485 goes in the same envelope (Filing packet tab → More… → VAWA self-petition (I-360)).

Gather the client's declaration and the evidence in the I-360 Instructions' order: the abuser's status, the relationship, living together, the abuse, good moral character (police clearances), a spouse's good faith marriage.
vawa_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder as it arrives (the receipt, a prima facie notice, any request for evidence, the approval).
Reach the client only at the safe address and the contacts the client chose; never through the abuser.
vawa_approved: Prepare the I-485 on the approved petition (Filing packet tab → More… → VAWA self-petition (I-360)); a permanent resident's spouse or child waits for a visa to be available.
With the approval, the client receives the work permit (c)(31) if Part 10, item 12 asked for it.
t_ready: Screen the T visa: a victim of a severe form of trafficking, present on account of it, who complied with reasonable law enforcement requests (or was under 18, or can't because of trauma), and would suffer extreme hardship on removal (8 CFR 214.202).
With the client and their counselor: the detailed, signed personal statement and the evidence (Filing packet tab, More filings, T visa).
Decide whether to ask a law enforcement agency for Supplement B. It is optional: the application doesn't wait for it.
t_pending: Add every USCIS notice as it arrives: the receipt, biometrics, a bona fide determination, any request for evidence, the decision.
Remind the client not to leave the U.S. while the I-914 is pending: it can cost the physical presence requirement (the I-914 instructions).
t_status: T status lasts up to 4 years (8 CFR 214.203(a)). The green card (I-485 under INA 245(l)) can be filed after 3 years of continuous presence since admission as T-1, or sooner once the investigation or prosecution is complete, and must be filed before T status ends (8 CFR 214.203(c), 245.23(a)).
Travel only with advance parole granted before leaving, or T status ends (8 CFR 214.204(p)).
u_certification: Find the agency that investigated or prosecuted the crime (the police report or the court record names it) and its own instructions for U visa certification requests: the address, and any form or portal of its own. Never a guessed address.
Build the request (Filing packet tab → More… → U visa: certification request), sign the letter, mail it with tracking and record the mailing.

When the signed Supplement B comes back, keep the original and record the date the official signed it (its Part 6, item 2): the petition must reach USCIS within six months of it (8 CFR 214.14(c)(2)(i)).
u_ready: File the U petition (Filing packet tab → More… → U visa petition) before the Supplement B's six months run out: the original Supplement B, the client's signed personal statement and the evidence.
Answer Part 3 of the I-918 with the client. If the client is inadmissible, Form I-192 goes with the petition (no fee for a U petitioner: Form G-1055).
u_pending: Add every USCIS notice to the folder: the receipt, the biometrics appointment, a bona fide determination or a waiting-list notice (record its date in the U visa petition's questions).
The work permit while the petition waits: USCIS recommends Form I-765 with the I-918, or now; no fee (uscis.gov/i-918, questions 8 and 10).
u_deferred: USCIS decides U petitions in the order they were filed, up to 10,000 principals each fiscal year (8 CFR 214.14(d)). Keep the client's address current with USCIS and add every notice to the folder.
u_approved: Tell the client: a principal in the U.S. receives the work permit automatically (8 CFR 214.14(c)(7)); a family member files Form I-765 for one (8 CFR 214.14(f)(7)).
daca_current: Keep the DACA expiration date in the case (the I-797 approval notice or the work permit): the renewal is filed 150 to 120 days before it.
When the window opens, review Part 4 (arrests, charges) and any trip since the last approval, then sign off on the renewal (Filing packet tab → More… → DACA renewal).
daca_pending: Watch for the biometrics appointment notice: the client must attend, or USCIS may deny the request.
Tell the client: no travel outside the U.S. without advance parole, and DACA ends on its date if the renewal isn't approved by then.

takeover._note: For a case another office started: shown until each item is marked done (or the firm records that it filed the case itself).
items: File a new G-28 with each pending USCIS case: {pending}.
Ask the previous attorney or organization for the complete file: copies of everything filed and every notice received.

Request the client's USCIS file (A-file) through FOIA, online at first.uscis.gov (USCIS takes FOIA requests online): the request is built for you (Filing packet tab → More… → FOIA request for the client's USCIS file (G-639)). It shows everything ever filed under the A-Number.
Look up each receipt number on USCIS Case Status Online and add any notice missing from the folder: {receipts}.
Make sure USCIS has the client's current address: Form AR-11 within 10 days of any move, and a change of address on each pending case.
Get a certified copy of the state court's SIJ order and confirm it is still in effect.
Immigration court: check the case's status (acis.eoir.justice.gov, or 1-800-898-7180), file an EOIR-28, and request the court record.

client._note: What the client sees in the portal after signing in (never in a text or email: those only say there is news). No legal judgments, no deadlines the client can't act on.

La petición fue aprobada y ahora sigue en el Centro Nacional de Visas (NVC) y después en el consulado. La oficina le pedirá sus documentos y le avisará la fecha de la entrevista.
en: Immigrant visa: NVC and the consulate
The petition was approved and now goes to the National Visa Center (NVC), then to the consulate. The office will ask for your documents and tell you the interview date.
ht: Viza imigran: NVC ak konsila a
Yo te apwouve petisyon an e kounye a li ale nan Sant Nasyonal Viza (NVC), apre sa nan konsila a. Biwo a ap mande ou dokiman ou yo e l ap di ou dat entèvyou a.

pt: Cidadania aprovada: a cerimônia de juramento
O USCIS aprovou a sua cidadania. Você se torna cidadão na cerimônia de juramento: leve a carta da cerimônia (Formulário N-445) e o seu green card. O escritório vai avisar a data.
es: Ciudadanía aprobada: la ceremonia de juramento
USCIS aprobó su ciudadanía. Usted se hace ciudadano en la ceremonia de juramento: lleve la carta de la ceremonia (Formulario N-445) y su green card. La oficina le avisará la fecha.
en: Citizenship approved: the oath ceremony
USCIS approved your citizenship. You become a citizen at the oath ceremony: bring the ceremony letter (Form N-445) and your green card. The office will tell you the date.
ht: Sitwayènte apwouve: seremoni sèman an
USCIS apwouve sitwayènte ou. Ou vin sitwayen nan seremoni sèman an: pote lèt seremoni an (Fòm N-445) ak green card ou. Biwo a ap di ou dat la.

pt: Petição familiar enviada: aguardando a vez
A petição do seu familiar está com o USCIS. Agora é preciso esperar a sua data de prioridade ficar disponível no boletim de vistos. O escritório acompanha todo mês.
es: Petición familiar enviada: esperando su turno
La petición de su familiar está con USCIS. Ahora hay que esperar a que su fecha de prioridad esté disponible en el boletín de visas. La oficina lo revisa cada mes.
en: Family petition filed: waiting for your turn
Your relative's petition is with USCIS. Now your priority date has to become available in the Visa Bulletin. The office checks it every month.
ht: Petisyon fanmi an depoze: n ap tann tou pa ou
Petisyon fanmi ou a nan men USCIS. Kounye a, fòk dat priyorite ou vin disponib nan Bilten Viza a (Visa Bulletin). Biwo a tcheke sa chak mwa.

pt: Preparando a sua petição
Estamos preparando a sua petição para o USCIS. Fale com o escritório só pelos contatos que você escolheu.
es: Preparando su petición
Estamos preparando su petición para USCIS. Hable con la oficina solo por los contactos que usted eligió.
en: Preparing your petition
We are preparing your petition for USCIS. Talk to the office only through the contacts you chose.
ht: N ap prepare petisyon ou
N ap prepare petisyon ou pou USCIS. Pale ak biwo a sèlman atravè kontak ou te chwazi yo.

pt: Petição enviada
A sua petição está com o USCIS. As cartas vão para o endereço seguro que você escolheu. Mande ao escritório uma foto de cada carta.
es: Petición enviada
Su petición está con USCIS. Las cartas van a la dirección segura que usted eligió. Envíe a la oficina una foto de cada carta.
en: Petition filed
Your petition is with USCIS. Letters go to the safe address you chose. Send the office a photo of each one.
ht: Petisyon an depoze
Petisyon ou an nan men USCIS. Lèt yo ale nan adrès sekirite ou te chwazi a. Voye yon foto chak lèt bay biwo a.

pt: Petição aprovada
O USCIS aprovou a sua petição. Agora preparamos o seu pedido de green card.
es: Petición aprobada
USCIS aprobó su petición. Ahora preparamos su solicitud de green card.
en: Petition approved
USCIS approved your petition. We are now preparing your green card application.
ht: Petisyon an apwouve
USCIS apwouve petisyon ou an. Kounye a n ap prepare demann kat vèt ou a.

client._vawa: DRAFT: the VAWA wording never names the abuse, VAWA or the abuser: someone else may see the client's screen. The attorney and a certified translator approve it.

pt: Preparando o seu pedido
Estamos preparando o seu pedido de visto T (Formulário I-914) com a sua declaração e os documentos. Tudo o que você conta ao escritório é confidencial.
es: Preparando su solicitud
Estamos preparando su solicitud de visa T (Formulario I-914) con su declaración y los documentos. Todo lo que usted le cuenta a la oficina es confidencial.
en: Preparing your application
We are preparing your T visa application (Form I-914) with your statement and documents. Everything you tell the office is confidential.
ht: N ap prepare demann ou
N ap prepare demann viza T ou a (Fòm I-914) ak deklarasyon ou ak dokiman ou yo. Tout sa ou di biwo a rete konfidansyèl.

pt: Pedido enviado ao USCIS
O seu pedido foi enviado ao USCIS. Não saia dos Estados Unidos sem falar antes com o escritório.
es: Solicitud enviada a USCIS
Su solicitud fue enviada a USCIS. No salga de los Estados Unidos sin hablar antes con la oficina.
en: Application sent to USCIS
Your application was sent to USCIS. Please do not leave the United States without talking to the office first.
ht: Demann lan voye bay USCIS
Demann ou an te voye bay USCIS. Tanpri pa kite Etazini san ou pa pale ak biwo a anvan.

pt: Status T aprovado
O USCIS aprovou o seu status T. O escritório vai avisar quando for a hora de pedir o green card.
es: Estatus T aprobado
USCIS aprobó su estatus T. La oficina le avisará cuando sea el momento de pedir la green card.
en: T status approved
USCIS approved your T status. The office will tell you when it is time to apply for your green card.
ht: Estati T apwouve
USCIS apwouve estati T ou a. Biwo a ap di ou lè li lè pou mande kat vèt ou a.

pt: Pedido da certificação da polícia

O escritório está pedindo à polícia, à promotoria ou ao tribunal que assine um formulário de certificação (Suplemento B). Isso pode levar semanas ou meses. Avise o escritório se a polícia ou o tribunal entrar em contato com você, e continue ajudando no caso quando pedirem.
es: Solicitud de la certificación de la policía

La oficina está pidiendo a la policía, a la fiscalía o al tribunal que firme un formulario de certificación (Suplemento B). Esto puede tardar semanas o meses. Avise a la oficina si la policía o el tribunal se comunica con usted, y siga ayudando en el caso cuando se lo pidan.
en: Asking for the police certification

The office is asking the police, the prosecutor or the court to sign a certification form (Supplement B). This can take weeks or months. Tell the office if the police or the court contacts you, and keep helping with the case when they ask.
ht: N ap mande sètifikasyon lapolis la

Biwo a ap mande lapolis, pwokirè a oswa tribinal la pou siyen yon fòm sètifikasyon (Supplement B). Sa ka pran kèk semèn oswa kèk mwa. Di biwo a si lapolis oswa tribinal la kontakte ou, epi kontinye ede nan ka a lè yo mande ou.

pt: Pronto para enviar o pedido do visto U
A certificação assinada chegou. O escritório está preparando o seu pedido (formulário I-918) para enviar ao USCIS em breve: ele precisa ser enviado dentro de seis meses da assinatura.
es: Listo para presentar la petición de visa U
La certificación firmada llegó. La oficina está preparando su petición (formulario I-918) para enviarla a USCIS pronto: debe enviarse dentro de los seis meses de la firma.
en: Ready to file the U visa petition
The signed certification arrived. The office is preparing your petition (Form I-918) to send to USCIS soon: it must be sent within six months of the signature.
ht: Pare pou depoze petisyon viza U a
Sètifikasyon siyen an rive. Biwo a ap prepare petisyon ou an (Fòm I-918) pou voye bay USCIS byento: li dwe voye nan sis mwa apre siyati a.

pt: Pedido do visto U enviado
O seu pedido está com o USCIS. Você vai receber uma carta para a coleta de digitais. Pode demorar bastante. Avise o escritório assim que receber qualquer carta.
es: Petición de visa U presentada
Su petición está con USCIS. Recibirá una carta para la toma de huellas. Puede tardar mucho. Avise a la oficina en cuanto reciba cualquier carta.
en: U visa petition filed
Your petition is with USCIS. You will get a letter for fingerprints. It can take a long time. Tell the office as soon as any letter arrives.
ht: Petisyon viza U a depoze
Petisyon ou an nan men USCIS. W ap resevwa yon lèt pou anprent dwèt. Sa ka pran anpil tan. Di biwo a kou nenpòt lèt rive.

pt: Aguardando, com permissão para trabalhar

O USCIS decidiu que você pode ficar nos Estados Unidos e trabalhar enquanto o seu pedido espera a vez. O escritório ajuda com a permissão de trabalho. Mantenha o seu endereço atualizado com o escritório.
es: En espera, con permiso para trabajar

USCIS decidió que usted puede quedarse en los Estados Unidos y trabajar mientras su petición espera su turno. La oficina le ayuda con el permiso de trabajo. Mantenga su dirección al día con la oficina.
en: Waiting, allowed to work
USCIS decided you can stay in the United States and work while your petition waits its turn. The office will help with the work permit. Keep your address up to date with the office.
ht: N ap tann, ou gen dwa travay
USCIS deside ou ka rete Etazini epi travay pandan petisyon ou an ap tann tou pa li. Biwo a ap ede ou ak pèmi travay la. Kenbe adrès ou ajou ak biwo a.

pt: Visto U aprovado
O USCIS aprovou o seu status U. O escritório vai conversar com você sobre a permissão de trabalho, viagens e os próximos passos.
es: Visa U aprobada
USCIS aprobó su estatus U. La oficina hablará con usted sobre el permiso de trabajo, los viajes y los próximos pasos.
en: U visa approved
USCIS approved your U status. The office will talk with you about the work permit, travel and the next steps.
ht: Viza U apwouve
USCIS apwouve estati U ou a. Biwo a ap pale avèk ou sou pèmi travay la, vwayaj ak pwochen etap yo.

daca_current._note: DRAFT: the attorney approves; the Portuguese and Spanish need the certified translator.
pt: Você tem DACA
O DACA e a sua autorização de trabalho valem até a data no seu aviso de aprovação. Vamos pedir a renovação de 4 a 5 meses antes. Não viaje para fora dos EUA sem falar com o escritório.
es: Usted tiene DACA
DACA y su permiso de trabajo valen hasta la fecha de su aviso de aprobación. Pediremos la renovación de 4 a 5 meses antes. No viaje fuera de EE. UU. sin hablar con la oficina.
en: You have DACA
Your DACA and work permit last until the date on your approval notice. We will ask to renew them 4 to 5 months before. Do not travel outside the U.S. without talking to the office.
ht: Ou gen DACA
DACA ou ak pèmi travay ou dire jiska dat ki sou avi apwobasyon ou a. N ap mande pou renouvle yo 4 a 5 mwa anvan. Pa vwayaje deyò Etazini san ou pa pale ak biwo a.

daca_pending._note: DRAFT: the attorney approves; the Portuguese and Spanish need the certified translator.
pt: Renovação do DACA enviada
Enviamos o pedido de renovação do seu DACA. O USCIS vai mandar uma carta com a data para tirar as digitais: vá ao agendamento. Não viaje para fora dos EUA.
es: Renovación de DACA enviada
Enviamos la solicitud de renovación de su DACA. USCIS enviará una carta con la cita para las huellas: asista a la cita. No viaje fuera de EE. UU.
en: DACA renewal sent
We sent your DACA renewal request. USCIS will mail you a letter with a fingerprint appointment: please go to it. Do not travel outside the U.S.
ht: Demann renouvèlman DACA voye
Nou voye demann renouvèlman DACA ou a. USCIS ap voye yon lèt pa lapòs ak yon randevou pou anprent dwèt: tanpri ale ladan l. Pa vwayaje deyò Etazini.

pt: Coleta de digitais (biometria)
Leve a carta do USCIS e um documento com foto.
es: Toma de huellas (biometría)
Lleve la carta de USCIS y una identificación con foto.
en: Fingerprint appointment (biometrics)
Bring the USCIS letter and a photo ID.
ht: Randevou pou anprent dwèt (byometri)
Pote lèt USCIS la ak yon kat idantite ki gen foto.

pt: Entrevista no USCIS
Leve a carta do USCIS, o passaporte e os documentos originais. O escritório vai preparar você antes.
es: Entrevista en USCIS
Lleve la carta de USCIS, el pasaporte y los documentos originales. La oficina lo preparará antes.
en: USCIS interview
Bring the USCIS letter, your green card or passport, and your original documents. The office will prepare you beforehand.
ht: Entèvyou nan USCIS
Pote lèt USCIS la, green card ou oswa paspò ou, ak dokiman orijinal ou yo. Biwo a ap prepare ou anvan.

pt: Audiência no tribunal de imigração
Leve a notificação da audiência e um documento com foto. Chegue cedo: faltar à audiência pode resultar em ordem de deportação. Fale com o escritório antes da data.
es: Audiencia en la corte de inmigración
Lleve la notificación de la audiencia y una identificación con foto. Llegue temprano: faltar a la audiencia puede resultar en una orden de deportación. Hable con la oficina antes de la fecha.
en: Immigration court hearing
Bring the hearing notice and a photo ID. Arrive early: missing a hearing can lead to a removal order. Talk to the office before the date.
ht: Odyans nan tribinal imigrasyon
Pote avi odyans lan ak yon kat idantite ki gen foto. Rive bonè: si ou manke yon odyans, sa ka fè yo bay yon lòd depòtasyon. Pale ak biwo a anvan dat la.

pt: Entrevista no consulado
Leve o passaporte, a carta da entrevista, os documentos originais e o exame médico. O escritório vai preparar você antes.
es: Entrevista en el consulado
Lleve el pasaporte, la carta de la entrevista, los documentos originales y el examen médico. La oficina lo preparará antes.
en: Consulate interview
Bring your passport, the interview letter, your original documents and the medical exam. The office will prepare you beforehand.
ht: Entèvyou nan konsila a
Pote paspò ou, lèt entèvyou a, dokiman orijinal ou yo ak egzamen medikal la. Biwo a ap prepare ou anvan.

pt: Cerimônia de juramento de cidadania
Leve a carta da cerimônia (N-445), respondida, e o seu green card. Chegue cedo.
es: Ceremonia de juramento de ciudadanía
Lleve la carta de la ceremonia (N-445), contestada, y su green card. Llegue temprano.
en: Citizenship oath ceremony
Bring the ceremony letter (N-445), answered, and your green card. Arrive early.
ht: Seremoni sèman sitwayènte
Pote lèt seremoni an (N-445), ak repons yo ranpli, ak green card ou. Rive bonè.

court_decisions._source: 8 CFR 1003.38(b)-(d) and 1003.23(b) (eCFR, current as of 09/30/2026; data/reference/8cfr1003.38.xml, 8cfr1003.23.xml). Appeal to the BIA (Form EOIR-26): within 10 calendar days of the judge's decision. 30 when the judge adjudicated an asylum application and did not deny it under INA 208(a)(2)(A), (B) or (C); counted from the oral decision or the mailing or electronic notification of a written one; a weekend or legal holiday moves it to the next business day; FILED WHEN THE BOARD RECEIVES IT, with the fee or Form EOIR-26A. Motions before the court: reconsider within 30 days and reopen within 90 days of the FINAL order; an in absentia removal order: reopen within 180 days for exceptional circumstances, or at any time for lack of notice or custody (only that motion stays removal). BIA Practice Manual 2.1: no mailbox rule; ECAS e-filing is mandatory for attorneys in eligible cases. EOIR notice: since 02/23/2026 EOIR fees are paid only through the EOIR Payment Portal (no checks or money orders); before asking EOIR for a discretionary stay with a motion to reopen or reconsider, request one from DHS (Matter of Herrera-Nunez, 29 I&N Dec. 691 (BIA 2026)). NOTE: the EOIR-26 instructions (Rev. Mar. 2026) still say 30 days for every appeal; the regulation as read (eCFR 09/30/2026) says 10 (30 for asylum): the earlier date is used and the attorney confirms. next_filings._note: The filing each stage leads to, first one first: [filing, label, now]. now = false when it is only if needed (travel) or later (a green card a year after asylum): the case page still shows it, but a filed case doesn't go back to the work list for it. Extra items (the I-751, the I-90, the EOIR-28, citizenship) are added by src/journey.py from the case's own dates.
i360_ready: File the I-360 petition (Special Immigrant Juvenile)
visa_wait: Prepare the I-485 packet now: it is filed when the priority date is current
i485_pending: Only if the client must travel while the I-485 is pending: advance parole (I-131)
consular: Immigrant visa: NVC tracking, the DS-260 answer sheet and the document checklist
Only if the client is in the U.S. and unlawful presence would bar them: the provisional waiver (I-601A), after the visa fee is paid, before the interview
asylum_pending: Only if the client must travel: advance parole (I-131), never to the country they fled
asylee: Green card as an asylee (I-485), from one year after asylum was granted
Spouse or children (I-730), within 2 years of the grant
family_wait: Green card application (I-485) on the filed I-130, when the priority date is current
caa_wait: Green card under the Cuban Adjustment Act (I-485), after one year in the U.S.
caa_ready: Green card under the Cuban Adjustment Act (I-485)
vawa_ready: File the VAWA self-petition (I-360), with the I-485 when it can go in the same envelope
vawa_pending: Only if not filed with the petition: the I-485 while the I-360 is pending, when a visa is available (an abusive U.S. citizen: always)
vawa_approved: File the green card application (I-485) on the approved VAWA self-petition
t_ready: Only if the attorney wants one: ask the law enforcement agency for Supplement B (optional evidence)
t_pending: Only if the attorney wants one: ask the law enforcement agency for Supplement B; it can be sent to USCIS later
t_status: Only if the client must travel: advance parole (I-131) before leaving, or T status ends (8 CFR 214.204(p))
u_certification: Ask the certifying agency to sign the certification (Supplement B)
u_ready: File the U petition (I-918) with the original signed Supplement B, before its six months run out
daca_current: DACA renewal (I-821D + I-765), 150 to 120 days before DACA expires

state_court._about: The state-court step for an SIJ case depends on the client's state (the I-485's physical address). DRAFT: the attorney approves each state's wording and deadline. A state not listed gets the stage's general steps only.

FL._source: Fla. Stat. 39.01(12) (2026): a 'child' is 'any unmarried person under the age of 18 years who has not been emancipated'. O.I.C.L. v. Department of Children and Families, No. SC15-1570 (Fla. Sept. 22, 2016): a private dependency petition filed about 2.5 months before the 18th birthday was dismissed as moot because the youth, now an adult, 'cannot be adjudicated a dependent child under Florida law'. Fla. Stat. 39.5075(4)-(6): the order includes the child's expressed wishes; once dependency is adjudicated the court may keep jurisdiction for the federal petition, never after the 22nd birthday. Read 10/02/2026 at leg.state.fl.us, flsenate.gov and flcourts.gov.
FL.deadline: Florida: the dependency order with the SIJ findings before the 18th birthday (a Florida court can't adjudicate dependency after it)
FL.too_late: The client lives in Florida and is 18 or older with no SIJ order in the folder. A Florida court can no longer adjudicate dependency (Fla. Stat. 39.01(12); O.I.C.L., Fla. 2016). The attorney decides whether any route remains.
steps: File a petition for dependency in the circuit court (Fla. Stat. chapter 39) asking for the SIJ findings, early enough for the order before the 18th birthday. The order needs the findings USCIS requires (8 CFR 204.11): the court's jurisdiction over the child; reunification with one or both parents isn't viable because of abuse, neglect, abandonment or a similar basis under state law; and it isn't in the child's best interest to return to the country of nationality. Florida also asks for the child's expressed wishes (Fla. Stat. 39.5075(4)).
If the I-360 and the green card application are still pending at 18, ask the court to keep jurisdiction for them (Fla. Stat. 39.5075(6): never after the 22nd birthday).
When the order arrives, add it to the folder: the system reads it and moves the case on to the I-360.
File the state-court case that asks for the SIJ findings (in Massachusetts, the CJP 35 complaint and the CJP 37 judgment) early enough to file the I-360 before the 21st birthday.
When the judgment arrives, add it to the folder: the system reads it and moves the case on to the I-360.
